command: /bin/zsh -lc 'for f in release.md 001_initial.sql 002_up.sql 002_down.sql old_reader.py new_reader.py; do echo "$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done'
aggregated_output:
release.md
     1	Deploy migration 002_up.sql first, then replace application instances one at a time. Old and new instances share the database during rollout. Rollback restarts the old binary first, then runs 002_down.sql. Staging has not run this release.
001_initial.sql
     1	CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
002_up.sql
     1	ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN name TO display_name;
002_down.sql
     1	ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN display_name TO name;
old_reader.py
     1	QUERY = 'SELECT id, name FROM users'
new_reader.py
     1	QUERY = 'SELECT id, display_name FROM users'
